category_definitions.same_local_code: Same local machine code after verified address translation; keep existing source and track dependencies.
category_definitions.verified_retained_source: Visible source with identical complete local instructions, matching DWARF calling/storage contracts and already reviewed direct call/reference targets; retain without another decompilation pass.
category_definitions.callee_binding_only: Same local instructions; retained callees need canonical 2022 binding/ABI review.
category_definitions.reference_review: High normalized score; unresolved code/data or indirect references prevent a strict identity claim.
category_definitions.small_diff_review: At least 90% normalized score; inspect the assembly diff and edit existing source before considering full decompilation.
category_definitions.full_review: Lower score or failed range/disassembly check; review may still expose compiler-only differences.
category_definitions.mapping_first: No unambiguous reccmp pair; fix pairing or compiler-part/inline coverage first.
category_definitions.cpp_review: C++/library helper, outside the initial C source triage.
category_definitions.reviewed_cpp_source: Complete C++ utility body, authored source and native ABI/storage manually reviewed; dependencies remain separately tracked.
category_definitions.reviewed_compiler_source: Complete native header specialization/instantiation and corresponding toolchain source reviewed; not authored recovery or strict rebuilt instruction identity.
category_definitions.reconstructed_source: Complete native body already reconstructed during consolidation; retain its provenance and track callees separately.

scope: Current card bodies in the mixed recovery/legacy build versus October 2022; helper roots are taken only from a fresh input-hash-verified helper review inventory; not a pristine historical 2020 comparison. Same-local-code requires exact instruction encoding apart from alignment NOPs, internal branch positions, equivalent unprefixed rel8/rel32 JMP/Jcc widths and verified function/source-string address translation. Unknown DLL data/code addresses, indirect control flow, incomplete disassembly and stub dependencies prevent that classification. EXE-owned fixed addresses and numeric/layout constants stay exact. A local match does not prove callees, global contents, gameplay or whole-program equivalence. High-score buckets are review priorities, not proofs of minor semantic changes. Deduplication candidates require ABI/caller, native-binding and provenance migrations before removal.

helper_review_seed.scope: Input-hash-verified existing helper body reviews; not inferred from reccmp scores.
